name: Yuushya Foliage Addon
author: Coco / coco_fish and the Yuushya creators
sourceNote: Official binary resource-pack release; no source repository or source commit is advertised for this asset. Pin the immutable CurseForge file ID and downloaded archive hashes, not a Yuushya Townscape code commit.
compatibilityEvidence: The author's file page explicitly lists Minecraft 1.20.4. The original archive declares pack_format 8, so preserve its bytes and record the selected pack in incompatibleResourcePacks rather than changing upstream metadata.
dependencyEvidence: The author's project description explicitly says Yuushya Foliage Addon does not require Yuushya 16x. Its archive contains vanilla leaf models, blockstates and textures. No additional mod dependency is declared.

license.redistribution: Permitted in modpacks with creator-page attribution, work title, noncommercial/share-alike asset conditions and the Yuushya component free of charge.
license.modifications: None. Upstream ZIP bytes and metadata are preserved. Client resource-pack selection is configured outside the ZIP.
